parameters.content:
## Function
Runs at 08:30 Europe/Berlin on weekdays. Selects confirmed sends at least seven days old, excludes won/lost/suppressed/replied/error records, and creates one deduplicated **manual review** activity. It never sends a follow-up automatically.
